svg.title: Multimodal annotation pipeline
svg.desc: Dataset readers retain native fields, units, calibration and clocks. An optional text LLM interprets field meanings. Dataset publisher declarations are retained. Optional field definitions supplied by the dataset publisher or user can override model-inferred meanings and layouts. Code checks recording quality. Annotation settings determine the recording profile, model, frame cadence and task scope. Long episodes are split into API requests with source timestamps and internal cut markers. A text LLM selects teleop image resolution; other profiles use defaults. Code prepares visual frames, recorded robot state, actions and sensor evidence and assembles data-dependent prompts and output schemas. When additional evidence is useful, the selected VLM chooses fields and windows, code reads samples or images, and results return to the VLM for at most two rounds. The final VLM annotates behavior, object state changes, scene relationships, data issues, operator mistakes, recoveries and sensor findings. Code parses responses, checks evidence citations and stitches request parts onto the episode timeline. The viewer and JSON export include usable annotations and reported gaps. The recovery example illustrates model findings; separate recording-quality checks are exported alongside annotations. Recorded RGB, tactile, depth and state examples illustrate saved model annotations. A paired handoff example shows an operator mistake and its recovery.
